message.content:
This appears to be a customs ruling on herbal tincture extracts. Candidates are heading 1302 (vegetable saps and extracts) and heading 3004 (medicaments in measured doses or retail packings), but the description gives no dosage or retail packing, so heading 1302 is the better fit.

Under 1302.19, "Other" vegetable saps and extracts, subheading 1302.19.91 covers other extracts, and 1302.19.80 is the other-extracts line. The 2022 HTS 1302.19 structure is:
- 1302.19.05 (Capsicum oleoresin?)
- 1302.19.10 (Medicinal... ?)
- 1302.19.15 (Ginseng...)
- 1302.19.20 (Ginseng extract?)
- 1302.19.40 (Mixtures...)
- 1302.19.80 (Other)
- 1302.19.91 (Other)

I recall 1302.19.91 being "Other: Other" and 1302.19.80.00 being a "Other" line. The subheading 1302.19.41 covers mixtures of vegetable extracts, and 1302.19.4100 is "Medicinal." Because these are medicinal botanicals extracted into a glycerin-water solution, 1302.19.91 seems the most likely line, but I'm not fully certain. I believe the "Other" line is 1302.19.9100 and will go with it.

{"hts_code": "1302.19.9100", "reason": "Liquid botanical extracts of medicinal plants (not in measured doses or retail packings) are vegetable extracts of heading 1302, falling under the residual 'other' subheading of 1302.19."}
